data.one_liner: Fast base encoding and decoding of any given alphabet using bitcoin style leading zero compression.
data.what_it_does: Provides a BaseXCodec class to encode byte data and decode strings using custom or standard variable-length alphabets. It is a direct derivation of the base58 implementation from bitcoin/bitcoin, generalized for variable lengths.
use_when: You need custom base encoding or decoding like Base58 for cryptocurrencies
You need to encode and decode data using non-standard variable-length alphabets
avoid_when: You require RFC3548 compliant standard base16, base32, or base64 encoding
You are looking for UI widgets or state management
strengths: Fast implementation of base encoding and decoding
Supports custom alphabets of any length
weaknesses: Not RFC3548 compliant for standard bases like base16, base32, or base64
Limited documentation outside of the basic README examples
